title: SMOK RPM Replacement Coils
description:
Description
Specifications
Sold individually. Please adjust the quantity to the desired number prior to ordering.
The coils comes in four types: Triple, Quartz, Mesh and SC. These coils allow users to customize their devices with their preferred coil preferences. In turn, these coils allow for Direct to Lung and Mouth to Lung vaping styles.
The 0.4ohm RPM mesh coils are designed for the best flavour and excellent vapor production. The 0.3ohm, 0.4ohm, 0.6ohm and 0.8ohm coils are for 0mg Freebase e-liquid, whereas the 1.0ohm and 1.2ohm coils are optimized for Nicotine Salt e-liquid.
Each replacement coil has two o-rings on the top and one o-ring on the base for a quick plug and play system.
RPM replacement coils are compatible with:
SMOK ALIKE
SMOK Nord 2
SMOK Nord X
SMOK RPM40
SMOK RPM Lite
SMOK RPM 2
SMOK RPM 2S
SMOK RPM80
SMOK RPM80 Pro
SMOK SCAR-P3
SMOK SCAR-P5
SMOK Fetch Pro
SMOK Fetch Mini 40W
SMOK POZZ X
Available in:
